# Elytra Combat 1.3.3 - Minecraft 1.21 through 26.2

Elytra Combat now runs on every Minecraft version from 1.21 to 26.2. One jar per API generation, each covering a range - pick the jar that matches your Minecraft version:

| Minecraft versions | Download | Java |
|---|---|---|
| 1.21, 1.21.1 | `elytra-combat-1.3.3+mc1.21.1.jar` | 21+ |
| 1.21.2, 1.21.3, 1.21.4 | `elytra-combat-1.3.3+mc1.21.2-1.21.4.jar` | 21+ |
| 1.21.5 - 1.21.10 | `elytra-combat-1.3.3+mc1.21.5-1.21.10.jar` | 21+ |
| 1.21.11 | `elytra-combat-1.3.3+mc1.21.11.jar` | 21+ |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `elytra-combat-1.3.3+mc26.1.x.jar` | 25+ |
| 26.2 | `elytra-combat-1.3.3+mc26.2.jar` | 25+ |

`SHA256SUMS` is attached for verifying the downloads.

## What changed

**Multi-version support.** Same gameplay everywhere, no behavior changes on 26.1.x. The codebase was split into a shared core plus per-generation compatibility layers that absorb vanilla's API changes across the range - the 1.21.2 `hurtServer` split, the `use_cooldown` item component with cooldown groups, the 1.21.5 NBT getter and effect-constant changes, the 1.21.9 rotation reshape, the 1.21.11 id/permission API changes, and the 26.2 screen-API removal.

**One note for 1.21/1.21.1:** those versions predate the item-cooldown component, so disabled elytras use a plain cooldown there and no original cooldown is restored when the disable expires. Every version from 1.21.2 on has full cooldown-group support.

Every jar's range is verified by compiling its compatibility layer against both endpoints of the claimed range, and the intermediary/official-name stability of every mod hook was audited across each version in between.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/user/elytra-combat/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for details.
